topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I can’t stop thinking about that ring, the one grandma wore all those years. I remember every detail, the way the light caught it, her smile when she talked about it. Seeing it in that pawn shop... it didn’t feel right. I should have told you right away, shouldn’t have kept it from you. I just froze, didn’t know what to do. What if someone else buys it? What if it’s lost to us forever? I’m planning on going back there, maybe I can hold onto it for you, find a way to bring it home where it belongs. I just need to figure out how to do this right.
